notes.title: Breakout Beyond Patch Notes For June 18, 2025
notes.content: [p]In addition to minor bug fixes as well as adding an option to change which input axis is read for mouse/joystick, today’s update introduces the ability to select your display orientation for some vertical brick breaking![/p][p][/p][p]To change your display orientation, navigate to OPTIONS, go to Layout, then change Screen to Vertical. Rotate your display and enjoy![/p][p][/p][p]You may see people calling this TATE mode! TATE (pronounced tah-tay) is a Japanese term referring to arcade games with vertically oriented screens, usually seen in vertical scrolling shoot-em-ups. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for continuing to enjoy Breakout Beyond![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - Patch Notes for 4/11/2025
notes.content:
This patch addresses the following:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where "Blast from the Past" achievement wouldn't unlock under certain conditions
[*] Fixes Infinite mode not being infinite
[*] Added D-Pad controls
[*] Added new leaderboard for Voyage mode
[*] Added Quality of Life improvements to level select screen
[*] Additional bug fixes
[/list]
